prBodyNotes: Merging deploys nothing. Run `scripts/ansible-sync.sh`, then `scripts/ansible.sh site.yml --tags quadlets --check --diff` before the real run; a changed tag restarts the containers that use it.

customManagers.description: Image tags in the quadlet settings: a `# renovate: depName=<image>` comment directly above `<name>_version: "<tag>[@sha256:<digest>]"`.

packageRules.description: The control-node image (base image, ansible-core, collections) is built by hand.
prBodyNotes: Merging changes nothing on the hosts. Build and push a new image with `control-node/build.sh <tag>`, raise `ansible_controller_version` in inventory/host_vars/rpi-01/quadlets.yml and restart the container by hand (`systemctl restart ansible-controller` on rpi-01).

packageRules.description: Internal registry, not reachable from GitHub-hosted runners.
InfluxDB 3 has a different storage engine and is no in-place upgrade from 2.x.
netboot.xyz tags look like 0.7.6-nbxyz26; the nbxyz number is a build, not a fixed suffix.
grafana-dev nightly builds are tagged <version>-<build id>.
haproxy: patch releases of the current branch as their own PR, apart from newer branches.
Immich server, valkey and postgres follow the docker-compose.yml of an Immich release.
prBodyNotes: Compare valkey and postgres with the docker-compose.yml of the new Immich release before merging: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases

packageRules.description: A new PostgreSQL major version needs a dump and restore of the Immich database.
The tika container's start command in the quadlet settings is copied from the image.
prBodyNotes: Check that the image's entrypoint still matches the entrypoint/command override of the tika container in inventory/host_vars/server-01/quadlets.yml.
